ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent and detect it.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are state and federal authorities working to prevent and detect Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant waste and abuse in the Medicaid system, and could lead to changes in how the program is administered and overseen.
